text:
maria: Heads-up, noticed onboarding sample app surfaces different failure shapes between Python and Go SDKs. It's confusing for users and QA.

sam: ugh, can you paste the examples?

maria: Python returns:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "AuthError",
    "message": "invalid api key",
    "status": 401
  }
}
```
Go returns:
```json
{
  "code": 401,
  "reason": "unauthorized",
  "details": "key expired"
}
```

maria: So different keys and wording, no typed field parity, and our retry hints are missing in Go.

raj: that's rough. We should pick a canonical shape and map SDKs to it. Suggestion: top-level `error` object with `code`, `type`, `message`, optional `hint` and `metadata` for vendor fields.

liz: Agree. Also keep HTTP status separate from internal code. i.e. `status` vs `code`. Users get confused when code==401 vs status==401.

sam: +1. For onboarding UX we should surface a short `user_message` for product-facing copy and a `dev_hint` for SDKs to log.

maria: Example proposal:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "type": "AuthError",
    "status": 401,
    "code": "API_KEY_EXPIRED",
    "message": "API key invalid. Update your key.",
    "dev_hint": "token refresh required, see https://redwood.ai/docs/auth"
  }
}
```

sdk-qa: we hit this in automated onboarding tests yesterday — the Go sample app expects `reason` and fails to parse `error.type`. I'll attach failing log in ticket.

raj: Can we add a mapping table for each SDK in docs and a small shim in Go until we roll parity? e.g., translate `reason`->`error.type` and populate `dev_hint` from headers when present.

liz: Also need to standardize status code mapping rules: 429 retryable with Backoff header, 5xx server errors -> transient, 4xx except auth/ratelimit -> client errors. Keep it consistent across SDKs.

sam: Where should this live? proposal RFC in repo or a short spec in devex docs?

maria: I'd like an RFC first for the shape and mapping rules, then quick devex doc + sample app fixes. I can draft the RFC this week.

devex-bot: Reminder: RFCs should be opened in the /rfc repo and include backwards-compatibility notes and migration plan. Tagging @all.

maria: action items: 1) I will open RFC by Fri (2234620000) with canonical error schema + mapping table. 2) @sam and @raj, please list current SDK deviations. 3) @liz, add status mapping section for retry semantics.

sam: will run SDK sweep tomorrow and post findings.

raj: i'll prototype a tiny Go shim that normalizes old shapes to the new schema.

sdk-qa: i'll attach failing CI job and test matrix ticket—will mark high priority for onboarding flows. :rotating_light:

liz: thanks all. this will reduce a lot of onboarding friction. :tada:

maria: thanks — if folks see critical blockers ping me directly.

devex-bot: RFC template: https://git.redwood/rfcs/new — please include example payloads, migration guide, and an e2e test plan.
